subject: Fix ORDERBY truncation in CLUSTER SLOT-STATS comparators (#4459)
reason: The fix only changes CLUSTER SLOT-STATS ORDERBY output when two slots' ordering statistic (key-count, cpu-usec, network-bytes-in/out) differ by roughly 2^31 or more, since the bug was a uint64_t subtraction truncated to int in the qsort comparators; below that threshold both the parent and fixed comparators order identically. Producing such a difference requires ~2 billion keys in a slot, ~35 CPU-minutes of slot activity, or ~2 GB of per-slot network bytes, none of which a throwaway fuzzer run can generate, and there is no DEBUG/config hook to inject slot-stat values.
